facts.text: Deborah received a letter from group members thanking her for the positive influence she had on them.

evidence.quote: Look what letter I received yesterday!
The group members sent this to me! They thanked me for the positive influence I had on them.

facts.text: Deborah's husband and she are trying to be as good a family as her parents were.

evidence.quote: My husband and I are trying to be as good a family as my parents were!

facts.text: Deborah mentioned that one of the places where she does yoga is in a living room with a television and a window.

evidence.quote: This is one of the places where I do it.
